behavior_contract.result: number[]: coefficients of the nth line of Pascal triangle

refactored_responsibility.name: calculateNextCoefficient(previousCoefficient, lineNumber, columnIndex)
refactored_responsibility.description: Extracts the coherent calculation of the consecutive binomial coefficient C(n, k) = C(n, k - 1) * (n - k + 1) / k from the previous coefficient. Clarifies intermediate state names previousCoefficient and binomialFactor.
clarified_state: previousCoefficient: C(n, k - 1), the immediate predecessor in the row
binomialFactor: (n - k + 1), the numerator multiplier in the recurrence relation
